name: Shade's Breath, Iron Man Armor — 'becomes … and gains "…"' and 'If this Equipment isn't a creature, it becomes …'
notes: Found with Kellan, Planar Trailblazer. Shade's Breath ('each creature you control becomes a black Shade and gains "{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn."') lost the colour and creature type because the sentence was cut at the period inside the quote: Grizzly Bears is a black Shade with the ability, the opponent's Gray Ogre is untouched. Iron Man Armor's '{2}: If this Equipment isn't a creature, it becomes a 0/0 Construct Hero artifact creature with flying …', fired, is about the Armor itself, not a target to pick.

$includes: {B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
